baseline_models.focus_anchor: The praise verb, the hand construction, dominion, totality, thinghood, and capability all occur inside 67:1.
baseline_models.mechanism: Stable increasing good is exercised through a gracious yet authoritative hand as effective sovereignty over the complete knowable domain.

activation_trace.role: Enduring increase in good supplies the positive quality by which the sovereignty is praised.
The hand as favor makes dominion a source of bestowed benefit rather than bare ownership.
The hand as effective authority gives the benefit an enforceable governing channel.
Royal sovereignty sets the scale of the hand's authority.
Comprehensive inclusion closes gaps in the governed domain.
Anything available to knowledge or report becomes an object within that total scope.
Effective capacity turns universal sovereignty from title into executable power.

changed_reading.before: A formula of praise followed by a claim of omnipotence.
changed_reading.after: The praise names a stable, increasing good that is actively administered as universal and effective sovereignty.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The stability branch of ب ر ك, the cohesion and organizing branches of م ل ك, and the measuring branches of ق د ر converge within 67:1.
baseline_models.mechanism: Dominion is not only possession; it is the principle that holds a complete field together by determining, preparing, and maintaining each limit.

activation_trace.role: Settled persistence supplies the model's stable state.
Internal firmness and cohesion explain how the domain remains composed.
The organizing mainstay makes sovereignty the support on which the whole order depends.
The whole gathers all parts into the supported order.
Exact extent and limit give the order determinate proportions.
Deliberate preparation and fitting provide the process that produces the measured whole.

changed_reading.before: Dominion is possession and capability is undifferentiated ability.
changed_reading.after: Dominion is measured cohesion: the whole persists because its organizing mainstay continuously fits each thing to a determined order.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The possessive hand, ownership sense of dominion, volitional branch of thinghood, and effective capacity are all focus-root branches.
baseline_models.mechanism: Possession, willing, and capability form an enactment chain: an intended thing can be brought into and kept within an owned order.

activation_trace.role: The possessing hand supplies direct disposal over what is held.
Ownership and disposition define the relation between ruler and domain.
The volitional side of thinghood makes objects potential outcomes of intent.
Effective capacity supplies the arrow from intent to realized control.

changed_reading.before: Things are a passive inventory under an owner.
changed_reading.after: The owned domain is dynamic: intention can become an effected thing and remain subject to disposal.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The settled branch of ب ر ك, authoritative hand, cohesive dominion, and narrowing branch of ق د ر remain focus-only anchors.
baseline_models.mechanism: The same authority that stabilizes and strengthens can impose a restricted measure; universal capacity includes contraction as well as expansion.

activation_trace.role: Settling fixes a thing in a state rather than requiring continual expansion.
Enforceable authority makes restriction an available governing act.
Cohesive force supplies the pressure that keeps a restricted state intact.
Narrowing to a small allowance introduces contraction into the range of capability.

changed_reading.before: Blessing and power are heard only as increase and release.
changed_reading.after: Stable sovereignty can also limit, withhold, and press a thing into a deliberately narrow measure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's measured capability becomes a purposive test-field when creation is itself measurement and death and life are arranged to disclose quality of action.

activation_trace.role: Prepared fitting anchors capability as deliberate arrangement.
Volitional thinghood permits created states to function as intended instruments.
Creation as measuring supplies the calibrated construction of the field.
Testing that exposes a condition supplies the field's diagnostic purpose.

structural_cues: 67:2 places death and life as two created poles and immediately assigns them the function of exposing better action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured creation and disclosure by testing; I infer that the paired created states are deliberately calibrated toward moral revelation; alternatively, their creation and their testing function may remain conceptually separate.

changed_reading.before: Capability means that any isolated thing can be done.
changed_reading.after: Capability designs a whole experimental order in which opposed states are fitted to reveal how agents act.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured dominion becomes an inspectable architecture: layered construction lacks mismatched spacing or rupture and outlasts the observer's repeated, exhausting search for failure.

activation_trace.role: Cohesion is the focus-side property tested by inspection.
Deliberate fitting supplies the architectonic process.
Repeated creation language contributes measurement and proportion to both act and product.
Superposed layers provide the architecture's stacked organization.
Distance or mismatch between parts names the defect denied by the scene.
Opening or rupture supplies the second failure mode that inspection cannot find.
Depleted human force marks the asymmetry between finite inspection and the order's persistence.

structural_cues: 67:3 commands inspection after describing layers and denied defects; 67:4 repeats the inspection until sight returns depleted.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies layers, denied mismatch, denied rupture, and exhausted sight; I infer that these are empirical tests of the focus's cohesive measured rule; alternatively, the challenge may expose only the observer's limits rather than describe an engineered system.

changed_reading.before: The opening asserts sovereignty without displaying its internal quality.
changed_reading.after: Sovereignty appears as a fault-resistant, proportioned architecture whose cohesion remains after repeated scrutiny exhausts the scrutinizer.

context_deltas.mechanism: The complete domain of knowable things turns inward: concealed speech and the source from which acts issue remain exposed to the creator, so capability is informed rather than blind force.

activation_trace.role: Complete inclusion prevents the inward domain from falling outside sovereignty.
The knowable and reportable object gives totality an epistemic dimension.
Disclosure to the knower makes secret and public states equally present.
The inward source from which actions proceed localizes the most concealed part of the governed domain.
Origination supplies the causal basis for intimate knowledge of what was made.

structural_cues: 67:13 equates concealed and voiced speech under knowledge, and 67:14 grounds knowing in creating.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies knowable thinghood, inward sources, disclosure, and origination; I infer that creative causality makes universal power epistemically intimate; alternatively, knowledge and power may be parallel attributes without a causal arrow between them.

changed_reading.before: Every thing suggests an external inventory of objects under force.
changed_reading.after: Every thing includes unvoiced interiors and the hidden sources of action, all governed with creator-level knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: Beneficent sovereignty becomes an inhabitable affordance: difficult terrain is made tractable, food is allotted within it, and movement through the domain terminates in renewed return.

activation_trace.role: Enduring good provides the beneficent quality materialized by habitation and food.
The giving hand frames terrain and sustenance as favor.
Effective capacity explains the conversion of difficult ground into usable space.
Facilitation after difficulty turns dominion into traversability.
Nourishing food makes the traversable domain life-supporting.
Revival after death gives the journey through provisioned space an accountable endpoint.

structural_cues: 67:15 moves in one sequence from making the earth usable, to walking, to eating, to return after death.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies facilitation, nourishment, movement, and revival; I infer that these form one governed habitat-and-return system; alternatively, the final return may function as a warning appended to otherwise ordinary provision.

changed_reading.before: Dominion is a realm possessed from above.
changed_reading.after: Dominion is also the designed usability of the ground beneath creatures, feeding their movement while directing it toward return.

context_deltas.mechanism: Stability is revealed as an ongoing act rather than an inert property: ground can sink and oscillate, wings contract, yet living bodies remain held through merciful power.

activation_trace.role: Settled persistence is the focus-side state that the context makes dynamic.
Cohesive force supplies the ongoing maintenance behind apparent stability.
Hand-like power anchors holding as capacity without requiring a physicalized reading.
Ground descending out of reach supplies the failure opposed to settled persistence.
Oscillation and wave-like motion expose the earth's possible instability.
Gathering like a closing palm gives flight a rhythmic contraction that echoes the focus hand.
Active retention supplies the causal support that prevents falling.
Tender mercy qualifies the sustaining force as care rather than mere restraint.

structural_cues: 67:16 makes stable ground reversible, while 67:19 places alternating wing motion inside an explicit statement of being held.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies possible sinking, oscillation, contraction, retention, and mercy; I infer that ordinary stability is continuous sustaining action; alternatively, earth-threat and bird-flight may be separate signs rather than one maintenance model.

changed_reading.before: Blessed dominion is a static condition of settled ownership.
changed_reading.after: Blessed dominion continuously holds unstable media and moving lives in viable relation, and its force operates as mercy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context repeats the focus's complete thing-domain but changes the terminal attribute from effective capacity to sight; universal power is thereby read as observant, discriminating care.

activation_trace.role: Focus-side completeness establishes the repeated scope.
Focus-side knowable thinghood defines the units within the scope.
Effective capability is the opening predicate revised by the parallel.
Repeated completeness makes the later statement formally commensurate with the focus.
Repeated thinghood preserves the exact domain while the governing attribute changes.
Vision adds attentive perception to the same universal scope.

structural_cues: 67:19 repeats the opening's totality construction after the held-bird scene but closes it with perception rather than capability.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact scope parallel with a changed predicate; I infer mutual illumination between capability and sight; alternatively, the two predicates may remain coordinate attributes with no revision of one by the other.

changed_reading.before: Universal capability can be heard as indiscriminate force.
changed_reading.after: Universal capability attends to every object in the domain it sustains; power and sight share one complete scope.

context_deltas.mechanism: The hand's authority becomes a two-direction support system: no substitute force can protect outside it, and allotted sustenance can be given or retained by the same capacity.

activation_trace.role: The beneficent hand supplies the giving side of support.
The protecting hand supplies aid and prevention of harm.
Capacity to narrow an allowance makes withholding part of governance.
Aid that makes its recipient prevail defines the protection for which no substitute force suffices.
An apportioned gift makes sustenance a governed allocation.
Retention reverses the flow of allocation and activates the focus's constrictive capacity.

structural_cues: 67:20 asks for an alternative protecting force; 67:21 immediately asks for an alternative provider if sustenance is retained.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies aid, apportioned sustenance, and retention in paired rhetorical questions; I infer that protection and provision are two outputs of one sovereign hand; alternatively, they may be independent proofs of dependence.

changed_reading.before: The hand signifies a general title of control.
changed_reading.after: The hand names the irreplaceable support relation by which protection and food flow, and by which either flow can be curtailed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Power over knowable things folds back onto the knower: the same sovereignty constructs the hearing, sight, and inwardly kindled center through which things become available to creaturely awareness.

activation_trace.role: The skilled hand supplies a craft model for the production of faculties.
Knowable thinghood provides the object-side of the perceiver-object relation.
Bringing a being into existence supplies the construction of the perceiving subject.
Auditory reception contributes one channel through which the world becomes known.
Visual perception contributes the second explicit channel of creaturely access.
The inwardly heated heart supplies an integrating interior center rather than another external object.

structural_cues: 67:23 assigns one subject both the origination of people and the making of their hearing, sights, and hearts before noting scarce gratitude.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies origination and a coordinated faculty list, while the focus supplies skilled-hand and knowable-thing branches; I infer a crafted epistemic interface; alternatively, the faculties may be enumerated gifts without any handcraft analogy.

changed_reading.before: Power governs objects already present to an observer.
changed_reading.after: Power also constructs the observer and the sensory-inward interface by which the governed domain can be perceived at all.

context_deltas.mechanism: Capability gains temporal precision: an event has an appointed bound, its knowledge remains present with God, and what is questioned as remote can rush into proximity.

activation_trace.role: A determined extent or term supplies exact temporal bounds.
Deliberate preparation supplies execution at the fitted moment.
An appointment bounded by time or place turns the challenged promise into a scheduled event.
Disclosure to the knower marks timing as known even when not disclosed to the challengers.
Presence with the possessor localizes the reserved knowledge.
Movement into nearness supplies the transition from questioned future to encountered event.

structural_cues: 67:25 asks when, 67:26 reserves the knowledge, and 67:27 abruptly presents the event as near and seen.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an appointment, reserved knowledge, and sudden nearness; I infer that focus capability includes exact temporal administration; alternatively, time may be supplied only by the later sequence while capability remains temporally unmarked.

changed_reading.before: Capability is timeless ability without a schedule.
changed_reading.after: Capability includes measuring when an intended event becomes present, without making that measure available to every questioner.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's basin and life-support branches become active in the closing water reversal: stable accessible water can descend beyond reach, while sovereignty alone can restore a flowing source.

activation_trace.role: Water retained in a prepared basin gives blessing a concrete image of stable availability.
Water by which a community can manage its affairs makes dominion materially life-supporting.
The giving hand supplies the direction from custody to accessible provision.
Literal water supplies the resource whose accessibility is reversed.
Descent into depth removes the resource from ordinary possession.
A flowing spring supplies the imagined restoration of accessible life.

structural_cues: The final question reverses present water into inaccessible depth and then asks who can bring an accessible flow.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies focus-side basin and sustaining-water branches plus context-side water, depth, and spring; I infer that the closing question materializes opening dominion as custody of circulation; alternatively, the focus water branches may be lexical side paths with no intended return.

changed_reading.before: Dominion is an abstract total possession.
changed_reading.after: Dominion includes custody of the hydrological condition that lets a community possess any viable world at all.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because bodily pressure, a road-center sense, and fitted measure are form-distant branches rather than direct glosses of the focus forms. It remains anchored in three focus roots and in 67:22's explicit inversion-versus-upright sequence. Downstream prose should present it only as a spatial contrast, never as a bodily description of God or a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The pressure-to-ground branch of ب ر ك at word 1, the central-course branch of م ل ك at word 4, and the fitted-middle branch of ق د ر at word 9.

activation_trace.role: Chest-to-ground pressure supplies the bodily extreme against which stable sovereignty can be contrasted.
The central course of a road or valley gives dominion a traversable axis.
Fitting a proper measure or middle supplies calibrated uprightness.
Being overturned onto the face supplies the failed orientation.
Integrity and uprightness supply the alternative bodily state.
The straight route turns bodily orientation into directed travel.
Balanced straightness completes the centered path model.

changed_reading.before: The opening praises stable authority in abstract terms.
changed_reading.after: The opening can cast sovereign order as untoppled, centered, and properly measured, against creaturely movement collapsed onto its face.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the water-bird branch is a remote nominal member of the focus root inventory. It remains valid as an activation because that same focus root also supplies retained water, while 67:19 and 67:30 explicitly supply held birds and water-source reversal. Downstream prose should call this an ecological resonance, not translate the praise verb as either bird or basin.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Two concrete ب ر ك branches at word 1, together with the sustaining-water branch of م ل ك at word 4.

activation_trace.role: A water-dwelling bird supplies the rare lexical bridge between the later air and water scenes.
Retained water supplies the habitat and stable-resource side of the bridge.
Water that lets a community sustain its affairs connects ecology to dominion.
Light flight supplies the aerial life-form explicitly inspected.
Retention keeps the flying life-form viable in its medium.
Water supplies the second medium whose availability is sovereignly held.
The flowing source completes the air-water ecology with replenishment.

changed_reading.before: Blessed dominion is detached from particular habitats.
changed_reading.after: As a contained resonance, blessed dominion holds living media together: winged life in air and communal life around retained, replenished water.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the cooking-vessel branch is highly form-distant from the capability adjective. It remains packet-anchored through the focus ق د ر inventory and the explicit ignition and boiling sequence in 67:5-7. Downstream prose should use it only as a bounded-transformation analogy and must not substitute a vessel sense for the focus adjective.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The vessel-and-cooked-content branch of ق د ر at word 9.

activation_trace.role: A bounded cooking vessel supplies a material image of contained transformation.
Ignited fire supplies the transforming heat.
Boiling and surging supply the visible process occurring within the severe domain.

changed_reading.after: As a material analogy, capability can include enclosing a process, applying transforming force, and bringing its contents to a determined state.

strongest_changes: Measured capacity became a calibrated test and an inspectable, fault-resistant architecture.
Stable dominion became continuous merciful holding across potentially sinking ground and moving flight.
Universal capability acquired total sight and extended to construction of the perceiving subject.
The sovereign hand became the irreplaceable channel of protection and provision, including their restriction.
Capability gained appointed temporal precision and hydrological custody rather than remaining abstract ability.
summary.what_was_special: The strongest latent movement came from convergences inside the focus inventories: م ل ك joined sovereignty to cohesion and sustaining water, ب ر ك joined enduring good to stability and retained water, and ق د ر joined effective power to measure, preparation, contraction, and bounded transformation.
remaining_uncertainties: The concrete path, water-bird, basin, and vessel branches may be productive analogies without being intended lexical senses of the focus forms.
The repeated totality construction in 67:19 may revise capability through sight, or may simply place two independent attributes over the same scope.
The hydrological reading has strong packet convergence but remains less morphologically direct than the measured-cohesion and beneficent-sovereignty readings.
